content: {"praised":["Humor is ridiculous, witty, and never feels stale.","Jason Bateman delivers a brilliant, outrageous performance.","Writing is original, sharp, and darkly comedic.","The film feels heartwarming despite its raunchy tone.","Kathryn Hahn adds hilarious moments as a reporter."],"criticized":["Plot is tasteless, dry, and poorly executed.","Film contains disturbing pedophilic content.","Script is muddled and confusing.","Ending relies on clichés and stupidity.","Characters lack believable development."]}
